conventions: Object references are by NAME (solutions, methods, material master entries by name + code). The loader resolves them against the target database.
"existing": the definition/solution exists on local LIMSV2 under that code/name (read-only check 2026-11-04). The loader upserts by code, so a prod database without it receives it from this record.

"complete": true means every field the API requires for this object is stated in an STM (or is a unit conversion of a stated value, see *Derivation). complete:false lists each missing field with its reason in "missing"; nothing is invented to fill it.
titrationEquivalencyFactor is mg per mmol/mEq (TestDefinition.TitrationEquivalencyFactor). Where an STM states mg per mL of a titrant of molarity M, F = mg per mL / M and the derivation is recorded.
replicateCount 1 on gravimetric/measurement/titration tests = the STM describes a single determination; confirm in gaps D.
physchemArea RawPackaging for new definitions; microbiology definitions have none.
A complete test definition may still depend on an incomplete solution or method: see titrantSolution / hplcMethod / icpMethod references.

proposedHouseDefaultsForTitrants.note: NOT applied. Values the local titrants use (SolutionMasters 21-28, 36-38); to be confirmed by the user before any titrant is completed.

testDefinitions.notes: Exists on local LIMSV2 (created by hand); likely absent on prod, the loader creates it from this record.
